description: He wears a dark forest-green knee-length noble tunic bordered with ornate muted gold knotwork down the front, cuffs and hem, over a cream underlayer visible at the neck, wrists and lower edge. A substantial dark green textured cloak drapes from a large round gold-toned knotwork shoulder brooch, with elaborately patterned gold borders and a fringed edge. A broad decorated brown leather-looking belt has a large central ornament and smaller round metal fittings with a hanging strap. Brown trousers tuck into tall cross-strapped brown boots. The cloak and tunic are wool-like; exact textile fibers are uncertain. No headgear or weapon is visible.
